_comment: Per tracker product: repo_terms (code scan), display_name, match_focus / differentiate_focus (rotates by gap_id for varied copy), fallback_no_hits (optional). Legacy: entry may be a string[] = repo_terms only.

match_focus: Guestcard + tour scheduling are the usual parity levers—trace their claim into your ILS handoff and self-schedule flows.
If they emphasize speed-to-tour, audit waitlist, syndication, and agent handoff before you promise feature parity.
Prospect experience wins on clarity: compare their messaging to your actual guestcard and tour confirmation paths.
differentiate_focus: Lead with Entrata stack depth (PMS + portals + ops) instead of a standalone tour widget story.
Stress operator workflow and reporting—what happens after the tour is booked matters more than the booking modal alone.
Position reliability and integrations (ILS, CRM) where thin competitors over-rotate on demos.
prospect-portal.fallback_no_hits: Add symbols you actually use under Applications/ProspectPortal (routes, modules, Vue/React entries) to repo_terms.

match_focus: Routing, queues, and agent desktop behavior are where lead products diverge—verify their story against your dialer and IVR paths.
If the move is AI or speed, check callback, skill routing, and SLA timers—not just the marketing slide.
Parity claims on omnichannel usually mean SMS/voice/email handoff; trace that in your lead pipeline code.
differentiate_focus: Highlight Entrata-native routing and auditability vs bolt-on dialer startups.
Emphasize compliance, recording, and multi-site operations for enterprise PMs.
Show how leads flow into leasing and applications—not a disconnected call log.
lead-manager.fallback_no_hits: Confirm Applications/CallCenter (or your routed path) in app-inventory and add queue/dialer symbols to repo_terms.

match_focus: Threading, delivery receipts, and template governance are the real feature surface—compare there first.
If they tout AI replies, map claims to your conversation model, escalation rules, and human takeover.
SMS compliance (opt-in/opt-out) is often where parity breaks; align product and legal before roadmap.
differentiate_focus: Message Center sits inside the full prospect/resident journey—sell continuity, not a siloed chat box.
Contrast enterprise controls (roles, retention, audit) vs lightweight chat vendors.
Stress PMS and portal context so agents are not switching systems per thread.
message-center.fallback_no_hits: Wire Applications/Chat in inventory and extend repo_terms with your thread/SMS module names.

match_focus: Application parity is workflow + rules (conditions, fees, guarantors)—scan those layers before UI polish.
If competitors push instant approval narratives, verify screening integrations and edge cases in code.
Lease signing and document packets are high-risk deltas; prioritize e-sign and template paths.
differentiate_focus: Differentiate on configurability for diverse portfolios vs one-size flows.
Emphasize fraud, identity, and compliance depth where speed-first vendors cut corners.
Tie applications to move-in and ledger—not a PDF graveyard.
online-applications.fallback_no_hits: Point repo_root at the Entrata app that owns apply flows and add screening/workflow tokens to repo_terms.

match_focus: Income and identity verification are integration-heavy—match competitor claims to your vendor hooks and fallbacks.
Document upload + manual review paths often matter as much as auto-decisioning.
If they advertise faster approvals, check throttling, re-verification, and exception queues.
differentiate_focus: Sell trust, audit trails, and PM-configurable policies—not just faster green lights.
Contrast fair-housing-safe workflows vs black-box AI vendors.
Highlight how verification feeds applications and move-in, end to end.
resident-verify.fallback_no_hits: Use Applications/ResidentVerifyPortal in inventory; add document/income provider symbols to repo_terms.

match_focus: Doc parity is templates, merge fields, and signature ceremonies—verify those before comparing AI blurbs.
Multi-party signing and versioning are common gaps vs slide-deck competitors.
If they mention bulk sends or packets, check batch generation and error handling in your stack.
differentiate_focus: Anchor on lease lifecycle + Entrata context (units, parties) vs generic e-sign tools.
Emphasize legal-grade controls, retention, and replay for enterprise legal teams.
Position integrated doc + ledger + portal instead of exporting PDFs forever.
docx.fallback_no_hits: docx often maps to composer root—set repo_root to the real package if possible, then enrich repo_terms.

match_focus: Feeds, field mapping, and syndication errors are the operational core—compare there when they claim new ILS reach.
Availability and pricing sync beats pretty listing pages for most operators.
If they push AI copy for listings, check where content is generated vs stored in your feed pipeline.
differentiate_focus: Differentiate on feed health, retries, and operator tooling—not headline AI fluff.
Stress Vacancy + PMS truth as source vs thin aggregators.
Show reporting when syndication breaks (per partner, per property).
ils-portal.fallback_no_hits: Confirm Applications/Vacancy (or your ILS app path) and add feed partner names you support to repo_terms.

match_focus: Campaign automation parity is segments, triggers, and attribution—validate against their launch story.
Email deliverability and preference centers matter more than template counts.
If they tout AI content, map to where copy is authored and approved in your app.
differentiate_focus: Sell closed-loop marketing + leasing data on one stack vs generic ESPs.
Emphasize governance, brand controls, and multi-property rollouts.
Contrast measurable tour and lease outcomes, not vanity sends.
marketing-strategy-hub.fallback_no_hits: Use Applications/Marketing in inventory; add campaign/segment class names to repo_terms.

match_focus: Review solicitation and survey timing drive outcomes—compare workflows, not just dashboard screenshots.
If they add AI responses, check moderation, brand voice, and escalation in your codepaths.
NPS/CSAT parity is often about distribution channels (email/SMS/in-app), not the chart widget.
differentiate_focus: Tie reputation to leasing and renewals—prove ROI vs standalone review bots.
Highlight compliance and authenticity (no astroturfing) for enterprise risk teams.
Contrast portfolio rollups and benchmarking inside Entrata vs siloed tools.
reputation-advisor.fallback_no_hits: Reputation often shares Marketing app—verify repo_root and add review/survey module tokens.

match_focus: Leasing AI parity is intents, handoff to humans, and PMS facts—not chat window chrome.
If they claim new channels (voice/SMS), trace connectors and fallback behavior in your assistant stack.
Ground claims in tour scheduling and application CTAs your bot can actually execute.
differentiate_focus: Differentiate on grounded answers from Entrata data vs generic LLM wrappers.
Emphasize guardrails, logging, and brand-safe prompts for regulated operators.
Show assistant + agent + portal as one system, not a separate bot SKU.
leasing-ai.fallback_no_hits: Point inventory at Applications/EntrataLeasingWebsite (or actual ELI package) and add intent/route names to repo_terms.

match_focus: ELI+ moves usually hit voice, SMS, or richer handoff—verify those modalities in code before roadmap.
Enterprise ELI asks about RBAC, languages, and property groups; match narrative to implementation.
If competitors bundle CRM + AI, check where your assistant stops and CRM begins.
differentiate_focus: Position ELI+ as the native leasing brain on Entrata data, not a pasted-in copilot.
Stress voice quality, telephony integration, and compliance recording where relevant.
Contrast total cost and admin burden vs best-of-breed AI stacks.
eli-plus.fallback_no_hits: ELI+ may live under Applications/Entrata—confirm repo_root and add voice/telephony tokens if you use them.
